title: Syrian-Style Grilled Eggplant with Tender Kissed Meat Skewers
description: A delicious and flavorful Syrian-inspired dish featuring grilled eggplant and tender kissed meat skewers, perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add the kissed meat to the bowl and mix well to coat.
4. Thread the meat onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, brush the eggplant with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
7. Grill the eggplant for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
8. Serve the grilled eggplant alongside the skewers.
